newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Energy to start flow testing at Mangahewa-2.
newsitem.headline: FCL Energy to start flow testing at Mangahewa-2.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Energy Division said on Wednesday it would start flow testing next week at its onshore Mangahewa-2 well in Taranaki in New Zealand's North Island.

"It's been reckoned for some time that there is a reasonably significant (gas) resource there...The bigger issue at Mangahewa is how produceable is it going to be. So there's a testing programme outlined to determine that, and really this is the beginning of that process," an FCL spokesman said.
FCL said it also expected to complete drilling in two days at Piakau-1, also onshore Taranaki.
"It is a well that was drilled some years back. We're going back in there just to retest the potential of it," the spokesman said. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
